tone_statements.quote: For example, the ten tonal categories in Debao Urban variety of Yang Zhuang (L8) present as the following tonal values: A1=453 (high- rising-falling), A2=31 (mid-falling), B1/DL1/DS1=55 (high level), B2/DL2/DS2 =33 (mid level), C1=24ʔ (low- rising with final glottal constriction), and C2 =213ʔ (low-falling-rising with final glottal constriction) ... In all, when being viewed in the Western method, the Debao Urban variety of Yang Zhuang has six contrasting tones which present the following tone values: 453, 31, 24ʔ, 213ʔ, 55, and 33.

tone_statements.quote: 王文敏和吕嵩崧通过对靖西壮语的单字调进行实验语音分析,提出靖西壮语的第3声调值应为44;第4声和第6声可能趋于合并;第5声是一个两折调,前段略凹后段为凸起的拱弧。进一步的辨认实验证明靖西壮语的第4声和第6声已经合并。（见《靖西壮语单字调感知研究》一文，载于《百色学院学报》2014年第4期）
tone_statements.translation: Through experimental phonetic analysis of the citation tones of Jingxi Zhuang, Wang Wenmin and Lü Songsong propose that the value of Jingxi Zhuang tone 3 should be 44; tones 4 and 6 may be tending to merge; tone 5 is a double-bend tone, slightly concave in its first part and convex in its second. A further identification experiment proves that tones 4 and 6 of Jingxi Zhuang have merged. (See 'A perceptual study of Jingxi Zhuang citation tones', Baise Xueyuan Xuebao 2014 no. 4.)
tone_statements.locator: quote is of the citing review (Guangxi Minzu Bao 2025-06-18 p. 7, sec. 2); the work's own abstract athttps://mzsf.cbpt.cnki.net/portal/journal/portal/client/paper/04d56be981b6a7ee9b9357f1ccc9b3d0carries the same wording minus the author names
tone_statements.check: quotation verified in source (minor differences in wording)
tone_statements.summary: Jingxi Zhuang citation tones (6 smooth-syllable categories): T3 = 44; T4 and T6 merged perceptually; T5 complex contour.

tone_statements.quote: There are six lexical tones in the open-syllables and syllables with nasal finals in Debao dialect: rising-falling, low-falling, high-rising, low-rising, high and mid tones. [p. 24, Table 1.4: No. | Tone Types | sticks | values] 1 high - falling [glyph] 52 / 2 low- falling [glyph] 31 / 3 high - rising [glyph] 325 / 4 low - rising [glyph] 213 / 5 high [glyph] 55 / 6 mid [glyph] 33. Table 1.4 The six tones of Debao dialect. The numbers of the tones are casually labelled. [p. 25] There are only two tones in the checked syllables of the Debao dialect. They can be considered as allotones of the high and mid tones i.e. /55/ and /33/ due to complementary distribution.
